_label: Hand-checked seller policies for cost ESTIMATES only. Policies change and can depend on PIN code and payment method; never present these as a seller quote. Hosts match VerifiedOffer.seller without a leading 'www.'. Entries marked unverified are shown as hints but never used for amounts.
_checked_by: Read from the public pages listed in source_url on checked_on (robots.txt allowed the paths; one request per page).

shipping.quote: We offer free shipping across India for all orders above ₹999. If your order total is below this amount, a minimal shipping charge will be applied at checkout based on your location.
shipping.note: Fee below the threshold depends on location and is not stated. The storefront script also sets free_shipping_price = 800; the FAQ and cart banner say ₹999, which is used. COD adds ₹125 (not included).

shipping.quote: Prepaid (UPI / Card) More than ₹500 FREE · Prepaid (UPI / Card) Less than ₹500 ₹50
shipping.note: Prepaid orders assumed. COD costs ₹30 above ₹500 and ₹80 below (not included).

gst.note: The product page does not say whether the price includes GST.

shipping.quote: Evelta offers free shipping on orders over Rs.1000. The minimum purchase amount for free shipping is based on the sub-total in your cart and does not include tax or any coupons applied. Any order below Rs.1000 is charged a flat rate of Rs.45 (+GST).
shipping.note: The threshold uses the sub-total before tax, which matches Evelta's ex-GST listed prices.
